meta.title: The best price on a vendor card respects sealed bids, masking and the stage's best-price switch
gaps: The setup vocabulary cannot create three auction records with sealed-bid, closed-envelope masking, and the best-price indicator disabled.
No available operation or field configures those three auction modes or the best-price switch.
The available read-back fields do not expose a vendor card's best price, so the expected absence cannot be asserted.
